title: feat: implement TPC-H benchmark suite
body:
## Summary
- Add all 22 TPC-H queries as a Clojure benchmark using the `io.airlift.tpch` data generator
- Follow the AuctionMark benchmark pattern (schema, data loading, Docker Compose)
- Subqueries split into multiple sequential queries with client-side result passing
- Set literals replaced with `or` clauses
- Assumes #214 (re-find), #215 (if), #216 (year), #217 (subs), #218 (starts-with?) will be implemented

## Test plan
- [ ] Start Triplox server and run `clojure -M -m tpch.main` from `bench/tpch/`
- [ ] Verify all 22 queries execute without errors
- [ ] Run via `docker compose up` from `bench/tpch/`
